summary: Holistic backend regression after FASE 1 / 2nd wave router extraction (auth, training_plans, sessions, exports, sharing). Created new pytest suite test_refactor_regression_wave2.py (25 tests) covering every endpoint listed in the review request, and re-ran the original 1st-wave suite test_refactor_regression.py (29 tests). Combined run: 54/54 PASSED (100%). All 2nd-wave routers respond correctly: auth.register/login/me/profile/roles, plan-features, periodization-models-catalog, cycle-durations; training_plans.generate-structure (model=traditional, sport=powerlifting, 12 weeks), training-plans CRUD with GET-after-delete=404, sports-catalog public, calculators/load (1RM Brzycki/Epley/Lander); sessions.macrocycles/competitions/sessions/calendar; exports.comprehensive-pdf (200 with %PDF magic bytes) and export/plan/{id}/pdf 404 for nonexistent macrocycle; sharing.boards/top public, boards/share+view round-trip, coaches/og/{slug}.png returns valid PNG fallback (verified PNG magic bytes), sessions/view/{nonexistent}=404. Legacy routers still depending on `from server import get_current_user` keep authenticating (verified via /api/coaches/me=200 and /api/periodization-library=200 with token, and /api/coaches/me=401/403 without). The tournament-PDF None-handling bug reported in iteration_82 is FIXED: TestTournaments::test_full_tournament_flow now ends with a valid %PDF. Login JSON still returns 'token' as documented.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/training_plans.py is 1510 lines — borderline. For FASE 2 split, consider extracting calculators (POST /calculators/load — completely independent) and the PDF/export block (lines 1303+) into routes/training_plans_calculators.py and routes/training_plans_pdf.py. This file already mixes structure generation, CRUD, sharing, calculators and PDF in a single module.

routes/exports.py is 1640 lines (largest router). The Material-Design PDF generator inside export_comprehensive_pdf alone is several hundred lines — pulling the PDF style/section-renderer helpers out into a /core/pdf_styles.py would dramatically improve testability and shrink the file.

routes/sharing.py:117 (POST /boards/share) is a fully public endpoint with NO rate limiting, NO size limit on `payload`, and stores an unbounded JSON blob in MongoDB with a 90-day TTL. Add at minimum: max payload size validation (e.g. <512KB), basic rate limit per IP, and reject share_id collisions explicitly. Same applies to /sessions/share.

routes/auth.py POST /auth/register currently does not return a JWT or auto-login. Frontend will need a 2-step flow (register -> login). If the product UX expects single-step onboarding, return `token` in /auth/register too.
Login response uses the key `token` (not `access_token`). Documented as intentional in this iteration. Worth normalizing in a future iteration with coordinated frontend changes.

All extracted routers correctly use `request.app.state.db` via `get_db` and a local `get_current_user` JWT dependency — DI is clean, /api prefix is preserved everywhere, and the FASE 1 split did NOT change any URL contract. Excellent refactor.
